idea-plugin.name: API Security Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Lightweight, 100% local API-security checks for Java and Kotlin: hardcoded secrets and API keys, plaintext HTTP URLs, TLS trust managers that accept every certificate, REST endpoints that expose a persistence entity directly (OWASP API Security Top 10 — Excessive Data Exposure / Mass Assignment), and OpenAPI spec checks for missing authentication and permissive CORS.

No network calls, no cloud dashboard, no background processes — every check runs in-process during the IDE's own background highlighting pass. Built after reviewing real, recent complaints against the market-leading security scanners: recurring IDE freezes and crashes during scans, broken suppression/ignore controls, and an "Ultimate Plus" paywall undocumented until checkout. Every rule here can be turned off individually, and none of them are held back behind a paid tier.

API Security Companion Pro (optional paid tier): Kotlin support for Excessive Data Exposure/Mass Assignment (the free tier's checks are Java-only), two more OWASP API Security Top 10 checks — Broken Object Level Authorization and Unrestricted Resource Consumption — and team rules shared via a .gaphunter-security-rules file committed to your repo, so a rule the team agreed on can't be silently disabled by one person's local settings.
